nodes.question: Which study investigates the ecological importance of elasmobranchs and their role in marine ecosystems?
nodes.answer: "The ecological importance of elasmobranchs" appears in the book "Sharks and Their Relatives II," emphasizing their crucial role in marine ecological dynamics.
